name: Xochitl Torres Small
summary:
Xochitl Liana Torres Small (first name pronounced  SOH-cheel; born November 15, 1984) is an American attorney and politician who was the 15th United States deputy secretary of agriculture from 2023 to 2025, acting as "chief operating officer" for the department. She was nominated by President Joe Biden in February 2023, and was confirmed by the Senate on July 11.
She was the Under Secretary of Agriculture for Rural Development from 2021 to 2023 and had served as a U.S. representative for New Mexico's 2nd congressional district from 2019 to 2021.
